answer: Anchor every agent identity to a 500 POA stake locked for 30 days, like an island with a single guarded causeway: a new agent must post the bond before it can earn, and each extra identity costs another full stake. A farm running 100 fake agents needs 50,000 POA locked for a month, while honest agents earn the bond back. Peers flag accounts whose answers cluster: if 5 or more identities submit near-identical text within one epoch, an opal-bright audit trail links them and each loses 50% of its stake. Sybils then pay far more than they extract.
